policy.rule: This file records credential names and approved storage locations only. Never add a value, sample, fingerprint derived from secret material, recovery code, MFA code, or private account data.
policy.runtimeRule: Client bundles may contain only entries classified public-configuration. All secret, signing-material, financial, identity-verification, and privileged tokens remain outside source control and outside EXPO_PUBLIC variables.

storageClasses.location: EAS environment variables scoped per environment; EXPO_PUBLIC values are embedded in the app binary and must be treated as public.
Supabase Edge Function secrets or the selected server secret manager; never mobile config, logs, packets, or source control.
Expo/EAS environment or credential service, or CI secret storage for non-interactive automation; never committed .env files.
Supabase project settings/Vault/Edge secrets for runtime and an approved local OS keychain or CI secret for operator CLI access.
Apple Developer/App Store Connect plus EAS managed iOS credentials; private keys are retained only in those systems or an approved encrypted operator vault.
Vendor console plus the server/EAS/CI secret store required by the consuming runtime; public SDK keys remain separately classified.
